description: Stocks with high earnings yield (cheap valuation) that also show strong intermediate momentum represent 'cheap improvers' where the market underreacts to fundamental improvement, so combining earnings yield rank with 126-day momentum (skip 21) should outperform momentum alone; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the best existing 126d-skip-21 momentum strategy (currently -3.26).
title: Earnings Yield Momentum · 126d skip 21 · Top 500 · Long Only
